Design engineer, consumer appliances
Brightwater Home is hiring in Louisville, KY. Hybrid, 3 days on site.

What you'll do

- Own plastic part design for countertop appliances from concept to tooling release
- Work with suppliers on injection molding and mold design reviews
- Run tolerance analysis on snap fits and fastened joints

What you'll need

- 3+ years designing molded plastic parts in Creo Parametric
- Solid understanding of DFM for injection molded parts
- Clear technical writing for design reviews

Nice to have

- Experience with sheet metal design
- Exposure to thermal simulation for heated appliances

Benefits

- Employee discount on Brightwater appliances
- Tuition reimbursement, including Autodesk Fusion classes

About the team

We're 12 engineers who love rapid prototyping and run a weekly Python club.
